_comment: IMM switching demonstration scenario v2 for sub-project A. Amplified divergence: CV-phase v0=3.5 m/s (was 2.5), drag-phase k=2.0 (was 0.5), amplitude=0.00045 (was 0.0005). Trajectory: CV phase frames 0-40 covers r=1m→8m. Drag phase frames 40-80: v(t)=3.5/(1+7t), r(t)=8+0.5*ln(1+7t); r(79)≈9.34m (stays under ~9.6m unambiguous range). KF-CV freezes its v=3.5 m/s estimate during drag-phase coasts and overshoots the rapidly decelerating truth; drag-EKF mispredicts CV-phase deceleration that isn't happening; IMM should crisply switch mode probabilities near frame 40 and track both phases.
